svg.title: Auroob Amjad, Lead AI Harness Engineer at Hyly. I build the rails AI agents run on. A floating night factory run by Pac-Man crews, where each building is an application she built: an AI software factory, with Claude Code, Node.js and systemd, multi-agent crews and gated CI; conversational AI agents, with Python, FastAPI, Redis, MongoDB and Qdrant, microservices, RAG and queues; evals and observability, with Langfuse, OpenTelemetry and LiteLLM, LLM tracing, evals and research; and production delivery, with Kubernetes, Docker, Google Cloud, Jenkins and Trivy, CI/CD, rollbacks and signed images. Four ghosts drift around the island: context rot, prompt injection, memory poisoning and long-horizon drift. A good harness sends them running.

g.text: I build the rails AI agents run on.
A good harness sends them running.
